key_strengths: Exceptional routing architecture: comprehensive 29-tool index with 'Use when' column enabling precise tool selection
Perfect scope separation: explicit exclusion of whole-pipeline work with clear delegation to genomics-workflow-acceleration
Strong version-awareness: guardrails prevent flag invention and emphasize checking version-specific references
Excellent progressive disclosure: 161-line SKILL.md with 32+ per-tool reference files loaded on demand
Comprehensive guardrails: 11 explicit constraints preventing common errors (no tool substitution, no path invention, no parity claims without comparison)

recommendations.title: Add inline rationale for tool distinctions
recommendations.problem: Table shows rna_fq2bam separate from fq2bam but doesn't explain why RNA needs splice-aware alignment inline
recommendations.root_cause: Use-when column describes context but not biological rationale
recommendations.fix: Expand rna_fq2bam table entry: 'RNA-seq FASTQ(s) → splice-aware BAM (STAR alignment) — use instead of fq2bam for RNA because intron-spanning reads require junction-aware aligner'. Similar clarifications for fq2bam_meth (bisulfite conversion), minimap2 (long-read alignment characteristics).

recommendations.title: Add fallback for missing reference files
recommendations.problem: Workflow assumes all 32 reference files exist; no fallback if pbrun-<tool>.md missing or outdated
recommendations.root_cause: Reference file structure brittle to incomplete installations or version skew
recommendations.fix: Add to Workflow step 2: 'If reference file missing for selected tool, fall back to NVIDIA docs at docs.nvidia.com/clara/parabricks/latest/toolreference.html#<tool> and note reference needs updating. Do not invent flags from tool name alone.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for command execution
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running same pbrun command multiple times produces identical outputs
recommendations.root_cause: Determinism varies by tool (alignment deterministic, variant calling may have stochastic elements)
recommendations.fix: Add to Limitations: 'Idempotency: Most pbrun tools are deterministic (same inputs → same outputs), but some advanced tools may use randomization. Check tool-specific reference for --random-seed or similar flags. For reproducible results, version container tags and reference genome builds.'
